  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Strengthening Healthcare

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

We prevent diseases by identifying high-risk patients early to enable timely use of medicines.

Our strategy

We stop disease progression by accurately diagnosing patients and delivering targeted medicines.

Our diagnostics solutions

while holding its open lid in a lab setting.]
Cure

### Restoring health through medicines

We cure diseases by identifying the cause of a patient’s condition and restoring health through
curative medicines.

Our pharma solutions

[ En savoir plus ][79]
[
[logo 15 ans sans RS]
][80]

## Les 15 ans de l'Autorité de la concurrence

L’Autorité fêtait ses 15 ans le 5 novembre 2024, dans le cadre d’un événement placé sous le haut
patronage du Président de la République.

[
[eco]
][81]

## Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN)

Créé en mai 2004, le Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN) fête cette année son 20ème anniversaire.
Entre mai 2004 et décembre 2023, les autorités nationales de concurrence ont rendu plus de 1 700
décisions fondées sur l'article 101 et/ou l'article 102. Les autorités nationales de concurrence ont
lancé en moyenne 140 enquêtes et adopté 75 décisions chaque année.

[
[podcast ]
][82]

## Cartels & Cie

Cartels & Cie est un podcast dédié aux grandes affaires démantelées par l'Autorité, qui se propose
d'emmener l'auditeur dans les coulisses de ses enquêtes, au cœur de scandales économiques impliquant
des entreprises mondiales.

[
[Guide PME]
][83]

## Espace PME

Dans une démarche de pédagogie, l’Autorité a créé un espace en ligne, intégralement dédié aux PME.
Un guide est mis à leur disposition afin qu'elles connaissent mieux les règles et puissent faire
valoir leurs droits.

## Contact

Des questions sur vos démarches, des procédures en cours... Contactez-nous !

[Poser une question][84]

## Les 15 ans de l'Autorité de la concurrence

L’Autorité fêtait ses 15 ans le 5 novembre 2024, dans le cadre d’un événement placé sous le haut
patronage du Président de la République.

[
[eco]
][81]

## Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN)

Créé en mai 2004, le Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN) fête cette année son 20ème anniversaire.
Entre mai 2004 et décembre 2023, les autorités nationales de concurrence ont rendu plus de 1 700
décisions fondées sur l'article 101 et/ou l'article 102. Les autorités nationales de concurrence ont
lancé en moyenne 140 enquêtes et adopté 75 décisions chaque année.

[
[podcast ]
][82]

## Cartels & Cie

Cartels & Cie est un podcast dédié aux grandes affaires démantelées par l'Autorité, qui se propose
d'emmener l'auditeur dans les coulisses de ses enquêtes, au cœur de scandales économiques impliquant
des entreprises mondiales.

[
[Guide PME]
][83]

## Espace PME

Dans une démarche de pédagogie, l’Autorité a créé un espace en ligne, intégralement dédié aux PME.
Un guide est mis à leur disposition afin qu'elles connaissent mieux les règles et puissent faire
valoir leurs droits.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[Cancer History Project On ][80]
What is the
Cancer History Project

The goal of the Cancer History Project is twofold: to collect and preserve the history of cancer
research, and to spark rigorous discussion of the achievements of the past half-century.

Created to mark the 50th anniversary of the National Cancer Act of 1971, the Cancer History Project
is a free historical resource that places a vast, expertly curated collection of primary sources and
authoritative interpretations within easy reach of researchers, medical professionals, students,
policy-makers, and patients.

The Cancer History Project is a new way of preserving history: collaboratively curated by the
institutions and people who shaped it.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

We Are Henry
Whether it's the challenge of a marathon or the sprint to save lives with specialized care, these
stories highlight what it means to be Henry.

## ** Former employee relies on Henry Ford Family after first colonoscopy reveals cancer**

For more than two decades, Brooke Wessman took great pride in working for Henry Ford Health. As
someone who prioritizes healthy living — exercise, clean eating and routine screenings, Brooke
received a colon cancer screening at age 45 with a Cologuard test. She was surprised when the
results detected altered DNA and/or blood, a possible sign of precancerous polyps or colon cancer.
[ Read Brooke's Story ][89]

## ** Back in flow following vascular surgery**

When Eric’s left bicep swelled up so large that it strained his shirt sleeve, he knew something was
wrong. This sudden development was a shock to Eric, then 39, a West Bloomfield resident. He was
healthy, had lived a very active life and his only previous medical issues were sports injuries when
he was growing up. Following many tests, an ER doctor referred Eric to a vascular surgeon who was
able to figure out what was going on and act quickly.
[ Read Eric's Story ][90]

## ** Nurse practitioner finds alternative treatment to thyroid nodule through RFA procedure**

Lisa Smith had a history of abnormal thyroid labs since she was pregnant with her son around eight
years ago. She also had a family history of thyroid disease, so when it was found that she had a
nodule on her thyroid that was causing it to be hyperactive, she was not surprised. She was hesitant
to undergo treatment because she would need to be on medication long term. But thanks to a new
procedure, she and her doctor were able to take action she was comfortable with.
[ Read Lisa's Story ][91]

We Are Henry
Whether it's the challenge of a marathon or the sprint to save lives with specialized care, these
stories highlight what it means to be Henry.

## ** Former employee relies on Henry Ford Family after first colonoscopy reveals cancer**

For more than two decades, Brooke Wessman took great pride in working for Henry Ford Health. As
someone who prioritizes healthy living — exercise, clean eating and routine screenings, Brooke
received a colon cancer screening at age 45 with a Cologuard test. She was surprised when the
results detected altered DNA and/or blood, a possible sign of precancerous polyps or colon cancer.
[ Read Brooke's Story ][89]

## ** Back in flow following vascular surgery**

When Eric’s left bicep swelled up so large that it strained his shirt sleeve, he knew something was
wrong. This sudden development was a shock to Eric, then 39, a West Bloomfield resident. He was
healthy, had lived a very active life and his only previous medical issues were sports injuries when
he was growing up. Following many tests, an ER doctor referred Eric to a vascular surgeon who was
able to figure out what was going on and act quickly.
[ Read Eric's Story ][90]

## ** Nurse practitioner finds alternative treatment to thyroid nodule through RFA procedure**

Lisa Smith had a history of abnormal thyroid labs since she was pregnant with her son around eight
years ago. She also had a family history of thyroid disease, so when it was found that she had a
nodule on her thyroid that was causing it to be hyperactive, she was not surprised. She was hesitant
to undergo treatment because she would need to be on medication long term. But thanks to a new
procedure, she and her doctor were able to take action she was comfortable with.
[ Read Lisa's Story ][91]

market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.

management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the

requirements.

## [ Facial Skin Changes Patients May Notice During Recovery ][25]

[Health][26]
Recovery is an important part of any facial beauty treatment. Whether a patient receives a chemical
peel, laser treatment, microneedling, facial surgery, or an advanced skincare procedure, the skin
often undergoes temporary changes before the final results appear.
For many patients, these reactions can feel unexpected if they are not prepared beforehand. That is
why beauty and wellness companies like NewBeautyCompany often focus heavily on post-treatment
education and aftercare support.
Understanding normal recovery changes helps patients feel more confident during the healing process.
It also allows beauty professionals to build trust by setting realistic expectations. While every
treatment and skin type is different, there are several common facial skin changes patients may
notice during recovery.

### Redness and Sensitivity

One of the most common [post-treatment effects][27] is redness. After treatments like chemical
peels, laser procedures, microneedling, or exfoliating facials, the skin may appear pink or red for
several hours or even days. This happens because many beauty treatments intentionally stimulate the
skin to encourage renewal and collagen production. Some patients describe the feeling as similar to
mild sunburn. During this stage, the skin may also become more sensitive to:
* Sun exposure
* Heat
* Harsh skincare products
* Fragrance ingredients
* Excessive touching
Beauty clinics often recommend gentle cleansers, hydrating products, and sun protection during
recovery. Professional aftercare guidance is especially important because using the wrong products
too soon can increase irritation. Most redness gradually fades as the skin heals.

### Dryness and Peeling

Many facial treatments speed up skin cell turnover. As a result, dryness and peeling are common
during recovery. Patients may notice flaky patches, rough texture, or visible shedding a few days
after treatment. This is especially common after:
* Chemical peels
* Laser resurfacing
* Retinol-based treatments
* Acne correction procedures
Peeling can vary from very mild to more noticeable, depending on the strength of the treatment.
Beauty professionals usually advise patients not to pick or scrub peeling skin. Trying to remove
flaking skin too early may increase irritation or affect results. Instead, clinics often recommend:
* Hydrating moisturizers
* Barrier-repair creams
* Gentle cleansing routines
* Avoiding strong exfoliants
Patients are sometimes surprised that dry skin can appear after treatments designed to improve
hydration or glow. However, temporary dryness is often part of the skin renewal process.

### Swelling and Puffiness

Some treatments can cause temporary inflammation, leading to mild swelling or puffiness. This is
especially common after:
* Injectable treatments
* Facial contouring procedures
* Laser therapies
* Surgical cosmetic procedures
* Microneedling sessions
Swelling is usually most noticeable during the first few days of recovery. Areas around the eyes and
cheeks may appear fuller or tighter than usual. Beauty providers often suggest cold compresses,
hydration, and rest to help reduce puffiness.
Patients are also commonly advised to avoid excessive heat, liquor, or strenuous exercise
immediately after treatment because these activities may increase inflammation. In most cases,
swelling improves gradually as the healing process continues.

### Temporary Breakouts

Some patients experience temporary breakouts during recovery. This can happen when the skin is
adjusting to increased cell turnover or when impurities trapped beneath the surface begin to clear.
Treatments that may occasionally trigger short-term purging include:
* Chemical exfoliation
* Acne facials
* Retinol treatments
* Deep cleansing procedures
Although breakouts can feel frustrating, they are not always a sign that the treatment failed.
Beauty professionals often explain that the skin may need time to rebalance. However, it is
important for clinics to closely monitor recovery. If irritation becomes severe or prolonged,
patients may need adjustments to their skincare routine or follow-up care. Professional guidance
during this stage helps prevent patients from overusing harsh acne products that could worsen
sensitivity.

### Tightness and Texture Changes

During recovery, the skin may temporarily feel tighter than usual. This is often part of the healing
process after resurfacing or collagen-stimulating treatments. Some patients also notice temporary
texture changes, including:
* Roughness
* Minor bumps
* Dry patches
* Uneven skin feel
These changes are often temporary and improve as the skin barrier recovers. Beauty clinics usually
recommend avoiding aggressive exfoliation during this stage. The skin may look different from day to
day while healing, which is why realistic recovery timelines are important. Patients sometimes
expect immediate results, but many professional treatments require patience before full improvements
become visible.

### Increased Sun Sensitivity

Many beauty treatments leave the skin more vulnerable to sun exposure. Freshly treated skin is more
sensitive to UV rays, increasing the risk of irritation and redness. This is why beauty
professionals strongly emphasize sun protection during recovery. Patients are commonly advised to:
* Wear broad-spectrum sunscreen
* Avoid direct sun exposure.
* Use hats or protective clothing.
* Reapply SPF regularly
Post-treatment sun care is especially important after chemical peels, laser procedures, and
exfoliating treatments. Without proper protection, patients may compromise their final results.
Beauty and wellness companies often include aftercare kits or personalized skincare recommendations
to help clients protect their skin during the healing process.

### Skin Appearing Worse Before It Improves

One of the most important things patients should understand is that the skin may temporarily look
worse before it looks better. Redness, peeling, dryness, or breakouts can make patients feel anxious
during the early recovery phase. However, many professional beauty treatments work by triggering
controlled skin renewal. As the skin heals, patients often begin to notice improvements such as:
* Smoother texture
* Brighter complexion
* Reduced acne scars
* More even tone
* Improved firmness
Beauty professionals play an important role in preparing patients for this timeline. Clear
communication helps reduce unrealistic expectations and supports a more positive recovery
experience.

### The Importance of Professional Aftercare

Recovery does not end when the treatment appointment is over. Proper aftercare is one of the most
important parts of achieving successful results. Beauty clinics often provide customized recovery
instructions based on the patient’s skin type, treatment intensity, and overall goals. This may
include recommendations for:
* Cleansers
* Moisturizers
* SPF products
* Healing serums
* Makeup restrictions
* Activity limitations
Professional follow-up appointments also allow providers to monitor healing progress and address
concerns early. Many modern beauty companies now focus on long-term skin health rather than quick
cosmetic fixes. This patient-centered approach helps create safer and more effective treatment
experiences.

### Final Thoughts

Facial skin changes during recovery are a normal part of many professional beauty treatments.
Patients may experience redness, peeling, dryness, swelling, sensitivity, or temporary breakouts as
the skin heals and renews itself. While these effects can sometimes feel concerning, they are often
temporary and manageable with proper care.
Beauty and wellness companies that provide strong aftercare support help patients feel more
comfortable throughout the recovery process. By setting realistic expectations and offering
personalized guidance, beauty professionals can help clients achieve healthier-looking skin and
build confidence throughout their treatment journey.

## [ Rebuilding Confidence After Leukemia Treatment: Understanding Reconstructive and Aesthetic

[Health][30] [Leukemia][31]

More than 18 million cancer survivors are living in the United States today, and advances in
treatment continue to improve long-term survival rates for people diagnosed with leukemia. Data from
the **National Cancer Institute** shows that survival outcomes for many forms of leukemia have
improved significantly over recent decades, allowing more individuals to focus on life after
treatment.

Recovery, however, often involves more than medical monitoring and follow-up care. Leukemia
treatments such as chemotherapy, radiation therapy, stem cell transplantation, and long-term
medication use can leave lasting physical changes that affect appearance and self-image. As
survivors adjust to life after treatment, many seek information about options that may help address
these changes. Resources provided by CNY Cosmetic & Reconstructive Surgery represent one example of
the types of reconstructive and aesthetic services that may be discussed within broader cancer
recovery support networks.

## [ Facial Skin Changes Patients May Notice During Recovery ][25]

[Health][26]
Recovery is an important part of any facial beauty treatment. Whether a patient receives a chemical
peel, laser treatment, microneedling, facial surgery, or an advanced skincare procedure, the skin
often undergoes temporary changes before the final results appear.
For many patients, these reactions can feel unexpected if they are not prepared beforehand. That is
why beauty and wellness companies like NewBeautyCompany often focus heavily on post-treatment
education and aftercare support.
Understanding normal recovery changes helps patients feel more confident during the healing process.
It also allows beauty professionals to build trust by setting realistic expectations. While every
treatment and skin type is different, there are several common facial skin changes patients may
notice during recovery.

### Redness and Sensitivity

One of the most common [post-treatment effects][27] is redness. After treatments like chemical
peels, laser procedures, microneedling, or exfoliating facials, the skin may appear pink or red for
several hours or even days. This happens because many beauty treatments intentionally stimulate the
skin to encourage renewal and collagen production. Some patients describe the feeling as similar to
mild sunburn. During this stage, the skin may also become more sensitive to:
* Sun exposure
* Heat
* Harsh skincare products
* Fragrance ingredients
* Excessive touching
Beauty clinics often recommend gentle cleansers, hydrating products, and sun protection during
recovery. Professional aftercare guidance is especially important because using the wrong products
too soon can increase irritation. Most redness gradually fades as the skin heals.

### Dryness and Peeling

Many facial treatments speed up skin cell turnover. As a result, dryness and peeling are common
during recovery. Patients may notice flaky patches, rough texture, or visible shedding a few days
after treatment. This is especially common after:
* Chemical peels
* Laser resurfacing
* Retinol-based treatments
* Acne correction procedures
Peeling can vary from very mild to more noticeable, depending on the strength of the treatment.
Beauty professionals usually advise patients not to pick or scrub peeling skin. Trying to remove
flaking skin too early may increase irritation or affect results. Instead, clinics often recommend:
* Hydrating moisturizers
* Barrier-repair creams
* Gentle cleansing routines
* Avoiding strong exfoliants
Patients are sometimes surprised that dry skin can appear after treatments designed to improve
hydration or glow. However, temporary dryness is often part of the skin renewal process.

### Swelling and Puffiness

Some treatments can cause temporary inflammation, leading to mild swelling or puffiness. This is
especially common after:
* Injectable treatments
* Facial contouring procedures
* Laser therapies
* Surgical cosmetic procedures
* Microneedling sessions
Swelling is usually most noticeable during the first few days of recovery. Areas around the eyes and
cheeks may appear fuller or tighter than usual. Beauty providers often suggest cold compresses,
hydration, and rest to help reduce puffiness.
Patients are also commonly advised to avoid excessive heat, liquor, or strenuous exercise
immediately after treatment because these activities may increase inflammation. In most cases,
swelling improves gradually as the healing process continues.

### Temporary Breakouts

Some patients experience temporary breakouts during recovery. This can happen when the skin is
adjusting to increased cell turnover or when impurities trapped beneath the surface begin to clear.
Treatments that may occasionally trigger short-term purging include:
* Chemical exfoliation
* Acne facials
* Retinol treatments
* Deep cleansing procedures
Although breakouts can feel frustrating, they are not always a sign that the treatment failed.
Beauty professionals often explain that the skin may need time to rebalance. However, it is
important for clinics to closely monitor recovery. If irritation becomes severe or prolonged,
patients may need adjustments to their skincare routine or follow-up care. Professional guidance
during this stage helps prevent patients from overusing harsh acne products that could worsen
sensitivity.

### Tightness and Texture Changes

During recovery, the skin may temporarily feel tighter than usual. This is often part of the healing
process after resurfacing or collagen-stimulating treatments. Some patients also notice temporary
texture changes, including:
* Roughness
* Minor bumps
* Dry patches
* Uneven skin feel
These changes are often temporary and improve as the skin barrier recovers. Beauty clinics usually
recommend avoiding aggressive exfoliation during this stage. The skin may look different from day to
day while healing, which is why realistic recovery timelines are important. Patients sometimes
expect immediate results, but many professional treatments require patience before full improvements
become visible.

### Increased Sun Sensitivity

Many beauty treatments leave the skin more vulnerable to sun exposure. Freshly treated skin is more
sensitive to UV rays, increasing the risk of irritation and redness. This is why beauty
professionals strongly emphasize sun protection during recovery. Patients are commonly advised to:
* Wear broad-spectrum sunscreen
* Avoid direct sun exposure.
* Use hats or protective clothing.
* Reapply SPF regularly
Post-treatment sun care is especially important after chemical peels, laser procedures, and
exfoliating treatments. Without proper protection, patients may compromise their final results.
Beauty and wellness companies often include aftercare kits or personalized skincare recommendations
to help clients protect their skin during the healing process.

### Skin Appearing Worse Before It Improves

One of the most important things patients should understand is that the skin may temporarily look
worse before it looks better. Redness, peeling, dryness, or breakouts can make patients feel anxious
during the early recovery phase. However, many professional beauty treatments work by triggering
controlled skin renewal. As the skin heals, patients often begin to notice improvements such as:
* Smoother texture
* Brighter complexion
* Reduced acne scars
* More even tone
* Improved firmness
Beauty professionals play an important role in preparing patients for this timeline. Clear
communication helps reduce unrealistic expectations and supports a more positive recovery
experience.

### The Importance of Professional Aftercare

Recovery does not end when the treatment appointment is over. Proper aftercare is one of the most
important parts of achieving successful results. Beauty clinics often provide customized recovery
instructions based on the patient’s skin type, treatment intensity, and overall goals. This may
include recommendations for:
* Cleansers
* Moisturizers
* SPF products
* Healing serums
* Makeup restrictions
* Activity limitations
Professional follow-up appointments also allow providers to monitor healing progress and address
concerns early. Many modern beauty companies now focus on long-term skin health rather than quick
cosmetic fixes. This patient-centered approach helps create safer and more effective treatment
experiences.

### Final Thoughts

Facial skin changes during recovery are a normal part of many professional beauty treatments.
Patients may experience redness, peeling, dryness, swelling, sensitivity, or temporary breakouts as
the skin heals and renews itself. While these effects can sometimes feel concerning, they are often
temporary and manageable with proper care.
Beauty and wellness companies that provide strong aftercare support help patients feel more
comfortable throughout the recovery process. By setting realistic expectations and offering
personalized guidance, beauty professionals can help clients achieve healthier-looking skin and
build confidence throughout their treatment journey.

## Lybrate: India's Best Patient Consulting Portal

Are you struggling to find a trusted doctor for optimal medical care? Look no further; search on
Lybrate! As India's premier patient consulting portal, Lybrate provides access to a database of over
150,000 doctors with expertise in diagnosing and treating conditions across various medical
specialties. With Lybrate, doctor consultations become effortless through a seamless appointment
scheduling process, granting you quick access to highly experienced doctors in just a few clicks. At
Lybrate, we are building the future of healthcare delivery by providing expert medical care on the
go.

## Lybrate Presence in India

Lybrate currently boasts a network of 150+ clinics, 800+ partner hospitals, a panel of 400+ super
specialist surgeons, and a database of over 1,50,000 doctors. Our presence spans 7 metro cities in
India - Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kolkata - as well as in several
Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Nagpur, Bhopal,
Ludhiana, Patna, Bhubaneswar, Coimbatore, Ahmedabad, Agra, Gwalior, Kochi, Vizag, Surat, Noida,
Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Jammu, and Guwahati.

We are continuously expanding our reach to serve people across the nation and beyond, providing them
with holistic and seamless medical care. For expert medical care on the go, choose Lybrate.

## Connect with Best Doctors in India for Various Categories

At Lybrate, we are committed to delivering comprehensive patient care spanning various medical
specialties.

**Proctology:** Specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the rectum and anus,
including but not limited to hemorrhoids, anal fissures, and colorectal conditions.

**Laparoscopy:** Involves the treatment of various abdominal and pelvic conditions using minimally
invasive surgical procedures. These surgeries employ small incisions and a camera for diagnosis and
treatment, resulting in a shorter recovery period.

**Vascular:** Focuses on conditions affecting blood vessels, arteries, and veins, with deep vein
thrombosis, peripheral artery disease, and varicose veins being the most common conditions.

**Urology:** This specialty involves the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the urinary
tract and male reproductive system, including kidney stones, bladder and prostate issues, etc.

**Gynecology:** This medical specialty deals with conditions of the female reproductive system such
as ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, and infertility. Pregnancy care is also an integral part of
gynecology.

**ENT:** Disorders of the ear, nose, and throat fall under this medical specialty. Common conditions
addressed by ENT specialists include throat infections, sinusitis, hearing loss, congestion, and
vertigo.

**Aesthetics:** Cosmetic procedures aimed at enhancing a person's physical appearance are part of
aesthetics. Some procedures include liposuction, tummy tuck, breast Lift surgery, breast
augmentation surgery, and rhinoplasty.

**Dermatology:** Dermatology is a branch of medicine that deals in the diagnosis and treatment of
conditions of the skin and hair. Some dermatological treatments include Botox, Derma Fillers, Face
Thread Lift, and Hair Transplant.

**Orthopedics:** Specialists in this field diagnose and treat musculoskeletal conditions affecting
bones and muscles, such as joint pain, arthritis, and fractures.

**Ophthalmology:** This specialty involves the management of treatments affecting eye health,
ranging from refractive errors to more serious conditions such as cataracts and glaucoma.

**Fertility:** This specialty focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the
reproductive system. In vitro fertilization and intrauterine insemination are some common fertility
treatments offered under this specialty.

**Weight Loss:** Weight loss involves safe and effective methods for achieving a healthy body
weight. Bariatric Surgery and Intragastric Balloon treatment are examples of weight loss procedures.

**Dentistry:** Dentistry encompasses diagnosis and treatment of diseases and conditions affecting
the teeth and gums. Common treatments include braces, aligners, and dental implants.

They then assist the patients in scheduling their OPD appointments and help them connect with the
best doctors based on their requirements.

### Q. Does Lybrate have its own hospitals?

Ans. No, Lybrate does not have its own hospitals. We work in association with other hospitals to
provide holistic care to our patients. Our doctors and surgeons perform procedures at our partnered
hospitals, utilizing the infrastructure of the respective hospitals.

## Lybrate: India's Best Patient Consulting Portal

Are you struggling to find a trusted doctor for optimal medical care? Look no further; search on
Lybrate! As India's premier patient consulting portal, Lybrate provides access to a database of over
150,000 doctors with expertise in diagnosing and treating conditions across various medical
specialties. With Lybrate, doctor consultations become effortless through a seamless appointment
scheduling process, granting you quick access to highly experienced doctors in just a few clicks. At
Lybrate, we are building the future of healthcare delivery by providing expert medical care on the
go.

## Lybrate Presence in India

Lybrate currently boasts a network of 150+ clinics, 800+ partner hospitals, a panel of 400+ super
specialist surgeons, and a database of over 1,50,000 doctors. Our presence spans 7 metro cities in
India - Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kolkata - as well as in several
Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Nagpur, Bhopal,
Ludhiana, Patna, Bhubaneswar, Coimbatore, Ahmedabad, Agra, Gwalior, Kochi, Vizag, Surat, Noida,
Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Jammu, and Guwahati.

We are continuously expanding our reach to serve people across the nation and beyond, providing them
with holistic and seamless medical care. For expert medical care on the go, choose Lybrate.

## Connect with Best Doctors in India for Various Categories

At Lybrate, we are committed to delivering comprehensive patient care spanning various medical
specialties.

**Proctology:** Specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the rectum and anus,
including but not limited to hemorrhoids, anal fissures, and colorectal conditions.

**Laparoscopy:** Involves the treatment of various abdominal and pelvic conditions using minimally
invasive surgical procedures. These surgeries employ small incisions and a camera for diagnosis and
treatment, resulting in a shorter recovery period.

**Vascular:** Focuses on conditions affecting blood vessels, arteries, and veins, with deep vein
thrombosis, peripheral artery disease, and varicose veins being the most common conditions.

**Urology:** This specialty involves the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the urinary
tract and male reproductive system, including kidney stones, bladder and prostate issues, etc.

**Gynecology:** This medical specialty deals with conditions of the female reproductive system such
as ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, and infertility. Pregnancy care is also an integral part of
gynecology.

**ENT:** Disorders of the ear, nose, and throat fall under this medical specialty. Common conditions
addressed by ENT specialists include throat infections, sinusitis, hearing loss, congestion, and
vertigo.

**Aesthetics:** Cosmetic procedures aimed at enhancing a person's physical appearance are part of
aesthetics. Some procedures include liposuction, tummy tuck, breast Lift surgery, breast
augmentation surgery, and rhinoplasty.

**Dermatology:** Dermatology is a branch of medicine that deals in the diagnosis and treatment of
conditions of the skin and hair. Some dermatological treatments include Botox, Derma Fillers, Face
Thread Lift, and Hair Transplant.

**Orthopedics:** Specialists in this field diagnose and treat musculoskeletal conditions affecting
bones and muscles, such as joint pain, arthritis, and fractures.

**Ophthalmology:** This specialty involves the management of treatments affecting eye health,
ranging from refractive errors to more serious conditions such as cataracts and glaucoma.

**Fertility:** This specialty focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the
reproductive system. In vitro fertilization and intrauterine insemination are some common fertility
treatments offered under this specialty.

**Weight Loss:** Weight loss involves safe and effective methods for achieving a healthy body
weight. Bariatric Surgery and Intragastric Balloon treatment are examples of weight loss procedures.

**Dentistry:** Dentistry encompasses diagnosis and treatment of diseases and conditions affecting
the teeth and gums. Common treatments include braces, aligners, and dental implants.

They then assist the patients in scheduling their OPD appointments and help them connect with the
best doctors based on their requirements.

### Q. Does Lybrate have its own hospitals?

Ans. No, Lybrate does not have its own hospitals. We work in association with other hospitals to
provide holistic care to our patients. Our doctors and surgeons perform procedures at our partnered
hospitals, utilizing the infrastructure of the respective hospitals.

### Q. Can I consult with a doctor online at Lybrate?

Ans. Certainly! Lybrate provides seamless online doctor consultations. We offer convenient online

calls or online chats. Our doctors ensure a thorough discussion with patients during these
consultations and suggest the best course of action.

## Why Use Lyfboat?

### **Find the right Hospitals & Doctors**

Researching hospitals and doctors can be time consuming and overwhelming. We simplify the process
for you. Using Lyfboat, you can find hospitals by treatment or location. We provide you with price
estimates, rich imagery, detailed hospital & doctor profiles, and previous patient reviews so you
can easily compare and select the right provider. Our goal is to enable you to make confident
decisions about where to get your treatment.

### **Quick responses**

We understand you are probably anxious to get better soon. Each hospital has dedicated international
travel teams that are available to respond to your queries in hours. They also help with planning
travel logistics such as accommodations, ground transportation, translation and more.

### **Medical Travel Facilitation**

Sometimes we don’t know where to start with the research. You can rely on our quality information
and guidance to assist with picking the right hospital and doctor. We can also assist with all your
medical travel needs. You can get help with booking flights, accommodations, transportation,
translation and more. We want you to focus on getting better.

### **Accredited Hospitals**

Undergoing any kind of procedure can be a bit scary. We hand pick each hospital & only
internationally accredited hospitals are included to ensure you will receive high quality care.

### **24/7 Customer Service**

Rest easy knowing real people are ready to help you 24 hours a day. You can contact us anytime via
website chat, email or telephone.

### **It’s free to use**

Patients can create a free account on Lyfboat and can do independent research for hospitals and
doctors as per their needs. Patients do not pay anything to Lyfboat for using its services.

## Why Use Lyfboat?

### **Find the right Hospitals & Doctors**

Researching hospitals and doctors can be time consuming and overwhelming. We simplify the process
for you. Using Lyfboat, you can find hospitals by treatment or location. We provide you with price
estimates, rich imagery, detailed hospital & doctor profiles, and previous patient reviews so you
can easily compare and select the right provider. Our goal is to enable you to make confident
decisions about where to get your treatment.

### **Quick responses**

We understand you are probably anxious to get better soon. Each hospital has dedicated international
travel teams that are available to respond to your queries in hours. They also help with planning
travel logistics such as accommodations, ground transportation, translation and more.

### **Medical Travel Facilitation**

Sometimes we don’t know where to start with the research. You can rely on our quality information
and guidance to assist with picking the right hospital and doctor. We can also assist with all your
medical travel needs. You can get help with booking flights, accommodations, transportation,
translation and more. We want you to focus on getting better.

### **Accredited Hospitals**

Undergoing any kind of procedure can be a bit scary. We hand pick each hospital & only
internationally accredited hospitals are included to ensure you will receive high quality care.

### **24/7 Customer Service**

Rest easy knowing real people are ready to help you 24 hours a day. You can contact us anytime via
website chat, email or telephone.

### **It’s free to use**

Patients can create a free account on Lyfboat and can do independent research for hospitals and
doctors as per their needs. Patients do not pay anything to Lyfboat for using its services.

## Beyond Ordinary Practice Management Software

### Integrated Electronic Health Records

Keep every consultation note, test result and document in one integrated EHR. Templates adapt to
your specialty, digital prescriptions and lab requests are built in, and everything stays a click
away during the consultation.

### Security

Guarding practice and patient data is our first priority. We encrypt the data transfer link and
segregate access based on the professional roles you assign to your colleagues.

### Free Chat and Email Support

Our experienced support team is there in the in-app chat and by email, ready to answer your
questions and help you get the most out of Medesk.

### Google Calendar and iCal Integration

Appointments sync daily with Google Calendar or iCal, keeping locations and times up to date.
Perfect for multi-site clinics or balancing NHS and private appointments.

### Friendly Interface

and practice managers from day one.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

Medesk helps private clinics attract more patients, cut admin work and keep every patient record in
one secure place. Start on the free plan, no credit card required.

## You're in Great Company!

Join **thousands of private clinicians** in more than **50 countries** who use Medesk to **improve
their workflow and deliver better healthcare** to their patients.

[Start free][81]

## Run Your Practice From Anywhere

Medesk works in the browser on any device, so your clinic is wherever you are. Doctors check their
schedule on the move, receptionists always see up-to-date information, and [video consultations][82]
run straight from the platform, wherever your patients happen to be.
* Easy access from any device
* Integration with online payment services
* Online booking and video consultations

[Start free][83]

[Run Your Practice From Anywhere]

## In-depth Analytics to Track Your Performance

Medesk comes with more than 80 ready-made [management reports][84] covering appointments, revenue
and staff performance, plus a report builder for anything custom. You don't need to hire a
specialist to make sense of your clinic's numbers. Reports are visual and always up to date.
* Exhaustive library of ready-made reports
* Visual reports at a glance
* Report builder to create new reports

[Start free][85]

[In-depth Analytics to Track Your Performance]

## Take Full Control of Your Clinic's Schedule

Create patient records and mark acquisition channels right from the [appointment scheduling][86]
screen. Doctors' schedules sync automatically with Google Calendar, Outlook and iCal on any device,
and Medesk adapts to the way your practice already works, not the other way round.
* Sync with Google Calendar, Outlook and iCal
* Workload analytics
* Tasks and reminders

[Start free][87]

[Take Full Control of Your Clinic's Schedule]

## All Your Patient Data in One Secure Place

Combine everything you know about a patient into a single [electronic health record][88]. Medical
history, lab results, consultation notes, documents and billing live together in one protected
profile, so whatever comes up during a consultation, the answer is one click away.
* Test results, consultation notes, appointment history
* Communication history, completed questionnaires and forms
* Produce [formatted medical documents][89] at the click of a button
* Billing, payments and tasks linked to the patient record

[Start free][90]

[All Your Patient Data in One Secure Place]

## Automated Tools for Professional Communication

Set up automated SMS and email confirmations and reminders, send bulk messages to the right patient
groups, and let patients book and manage appointments themselves in the [online patient portal][91].
Fewer no-shows, less phone time for your front desk.
* Automated SMS and email confirmations and reminders
* Bulk SMS and online forms
* Keep track of every message and document sent to patients
* Online booking and patient portal

[Start free][92]

[Automated Tools for Professional Communication]

## Your Patients' Data Is Safe and Secure

The [security of your data][93] is vitally important to us. Data is encrypted in transfer and in
storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access rights let you decide exactly what each
member of your team can see and do. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.
* Encrypted data storage and transfer
* Individual access rights for each role
* Automatic backup copies of your data

[Start free][94]

## Beyond Ordinary Practice Management Software

### Integrated Electronic Health Records

Keep every consultation note, test result and document in one integrated EHR. Templates adapt to
your specialty, digital prescriptions and lab requests are built in, and everything stays a click
away during the consultation.

### Security

Guarding practice and patient data is our first priority. We encrypt the data transfer link and
segregate access based on the professional roles you assign to your colleagues.

### Free Chat and Email Support

Our experienced support team is there in the in-app chat and by email, ready to answer your
questions and help you get the most out of Medesk.

### Google Calendar and iCal Integration

Appointments sync daily with Google Calendar or iCal, keeping locations and times up to date.
Perfect for multi-site clinics or balancing NHS and private appointments.

### Friendly Interface

No lengthy tutorials needed. The simple interface means less hassle for practitioners, receptionists
and practice managers from day one.

## Connected Solutions

## One System for Any Type of Medical Practice

Medesk brings together all the tools you need to run a clinic, from the front desk to the
consultation room.

**Medesk helps you keep an eye on:**

**1.** How many new and returning patients you are seeing

**2.** Which acquisition channels actually perform

**3.** Timely production of paperwork

**4.** Every diagnosis and treatment plan, recorded in the [EHR][95]

**5.** No-show and cancellation rates, and how to reduce them

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

Dr Hind Al-Husain
The Holistic Womens Clinic, Founder and Holistic Gynaecologist

I was very impressed with the professionalism and care taken to setup Medesk as my practice
management system. Whilst dealing with Dr May, I was confident in his ability to deliver the product
I wanted in the way I wanted - which he did in the time frame agreed and was readily accessible
throughout. Medesk is a fantastic system which is intuitive, user-friendly and very easy to use
without any loss of high-end functionality and is fully compliant with all legislation.

Try it. The free plan is free forever, and Pro comes with a 7-day trial, no credit card required.

Advanced Care at Home empowers parents to safely manage their child’s care with access to 24/7

## Life-Changing Research

Nemours is leading important pediatric research and clinical trials. We’re preventing and reversing
the course of childhood diseases, improving health care delivery, and keeping children safe and
healthy for generations to come. We partner with renowned medical schools and organizations to find
answers to the most pressing questions in kids’ health. Our discoveries help children in your
community and all over the world.

[Graphic icon of a lightbulb with a brain inside]

300+ Pediatric Medical Researchers

[Graphic icon of a microscope]

11 Research Centers

[Graphic icon of DNA]

240+ Clinical Trials Across the U.S.

[Graphic icon of a certificate with an award ribbon]

400+ Peer-Reviewed Publications Last Year

[Young patient and his mom high-five as they leave a group of hospital workers, all are wearing
masks.]

## Careers — Positions Available Immediately

There’s never been a better time to join our team — we’re hiring nurses, physicians, medical
assistants, and many more.

[ See Where You Fit ][90]

## Donations and Volunteering

Nemours has set out to change the definition of children’s health. We believe good health goes
beyond great medicine. Good health involves education and access to food and housing. It includes
strong families. It addresses mental wellness, health outcomes, and justice for all. And so much
more. Join us.

NEMOURS IN THE NEWS

### Nemours Launches Nation’s 1st At-Home Pediatric Care Program

Advanced Care at Home empowers parents to safely manage their child’s care with access to 24/7
virtual support and personalized care.

][89]

## Life-Changing Research

Nemours is leading important pediatric research and clinical trials. We’re preventing and reversing
the course of childhood diseases, improving health care delivery, and keeping children safe and
healthy for generations to come. We partner with renowned medical schools and organizations to find
answers to the most pressing questions in kids’ health. Our discoveries help children in your
community and all over the world.

[Graphic icon of a lightbulb with a brain inside]

300+ Pediatric Medical Researchers

[Graphic icon of a microscope]

11 Research Centers

[Graphic icon of DNA]

240+ Clinical Trials Across the U.S.

[Graphic icon of a certificate with an award ribbon]

400+ Peer-Reviewed Publications Last Year

[Young patient and his mom high-five as they leave a group of hospital workers, all are wearing
masks.]

## Careers — Positions Available Immediately

There’s never been a better time to join our team — we’re hiring nurses, physicians, medical
assistants, and many more.

[ See Where You Fit ][90]

## Donations and Volunteering

Nemours has set out to change the definition of children’s health. We believe good health goes
beyond great medicine. Good health involves education and access to food and housing. It includes
strong families. It addresses mental wellness, health outcomes, and justice for all. And so much
more. Join us.

[ How You Can Help ][91]

accurate, and verifiable through what we call N.E.X.T. Insights - so you can trust what you see.

## About

#### Starting with Charles Pfizer inventing an almond-flavored antiparasite medicine in 1849, our
#### people have always been innovators and trailblazers, committed to finding the next cure.

# Best Multi-Speciality Hospital in Hyderabad

From the last three decades, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has been providing quality healthcare for
the people in their diverse medical needs. People trust us because of the strong relationships we’ve
built with them over the years.

Under astute leadership and strong management, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has evolved as a centre of
excellence in medicine providing the highest quality standards of medical treatment to all sections
of the society. Our work has always been guided by the needs of patients and delivered by our
perfectly combined revolutionary technology, best medical expertise and advanced procedures.
